payload.lens: studio/checklists/seo-strategist.md (applied to copy) + studio/standards/linking.md + 11-ai-search content_requirements + decisions D7, D9, D14

findings.issue: 'Portugal wedding venues', the largest term in the set (US 1,900, UK 1,300, AU 90 per 10-keyword-research), is not in the title as a phrase, not in the H1 and not in any H2 or H3. The live page targets it in both title and H1 (F013), so this revision removes it from every heading-level signal at once. Title (D7) and H1 (D12) are binding, so the remaining lever is one heading.
findings.evidence: Title: 'Wedding in Portugal | Venues by Region | Wedded Wonderland'. H1: 'Get Married in Portugal, from a Sintra Palace to an Algarve Cliff'. H2s: 'Fall for Portugal Before You Choose a Venue', 'Choose Your Region of Portugal', 'See Why Couples Marry in Portugal', 'Pick the Setting for Your Ceremony', ... Exact phrase count in the whole payload: 3 (hero first sentence, s2 intro). Self-QA check 8 reports a pass because the H1 carries 'Get Married in Portugal', which is neither target phrase.
findings.suggested_fix: Project Lead: ask the user to approve the phrase in one H2, for example s2 'Choose Your Region: Portugal Wedding Venues' or s4 'Pick the Setting: Portugal Wedding Venues by Type' (title case per D14). Copywriter: put 'wedding in Portugal' or 'Portugal wedding venues' in og_title, which no decision fixes (it currently repeats the H1), and correct self_qa check 8 to say the H1 carries neither target phrase and that D12 accepts this.

findings.issue: Copy is over the brief range of 2,400 to 3,200 words. D14 requires the cut in revision 2. The two cuts D14 names (about 200 words) are not enough by themselves.
findings.evidence: payload.word_count = 3634. Reviewer's count of visible fallback copy (form, hidden s8 and the duplicate add-beach-line entry excluded): about 3,520. By block: s5-plan 937 (When to go 111, Getting there 60, Entry rules 133, Marrying legally 466, Timeline 89, Your weekend 50), s11-faq 730, s2-regions 261, b16-spotlight 223, s10-advisor 192, s3-reasons 152, s4-settings 146.
findings.suggested_fix: Best cuts, largest and least harmful first: (1) Remove the When to go tab, about 111 words (D14). FAQ 5 keeps the PAA answer; move the wildfire line ('wildfire risk is highest from June to September', F068) into FAQ 5 or the Your weekend tab because that is its only home. (2) Remove the Timeline tab, about 89 words (D14). The one-month and six-month rules are already in the Marrying legally steps and FAQ 1. (3) Drop the repeated brand sentence in s10-advisor, about 28 words. It is word for word the hero sentence; the GEO requirement asks for it once. (4) Repeated beach-permit rule, about 60 words: keep it in the s2 Algarve card and FAQ 8. Cut the permit sentence from FAQ 7, the permit clauses from s3 'Beaches and clifftops', s4 'Clifftop or beach' and s9 'Vow renewal', and the permit sentence from the b16 fallback card. It appears 8 times now. (5) s10 'Your Wedded Advisor' paragraph, about 25 words: shorten the restated contract-check list (rooms, buy-outs, minimums, VAT) to 'checks each venue contract before you sign', because add-venue-charges carries the detail. (6) Your weekend tab first sentence, about 25 words: it repeats the s6 list. (7) s7 airport sentence, about 15 words: airports are already on every region card, in s3, in Getting there and in FAQ 6. Keep the entry-rules link. (8) b16 Monserrate roof clause, about 10 words: it is repeated in the caption, the palace strip and FAQ 10. Together these come to about 360 words and bring the page to roughly 3,150 to 3,270 by either count. Re-measure after cutting. Do not cut the per-card 'Best months' or 'Guests' lines: the brief and 11-ai-search require the same labelled lines on every card.

findings.issue: FAQ 2 departs from the PAA wording it targets, and FAQ 3 has no PAA or related-search source (seo-strategist check 5).
